local W=workspace:FindFirstChild("FantasySurvivalWorld") local p=game.Players:GetPlayers()[1] local c=p.Character local Cfg for _,m in ipairs(game:GetDescendants()) do if m:IsA("ModuleScript") and m.Name=="GameConfig" then local ok,r=pcall(require,m) if ok and r.MeadowEquipment then Cfg=r break end end end
if not Cfg then return "no config" end
local function give(id) for i,it in ipairs(Cfg.MeadowEquipment) do if it.Id==id then local f=i<=32 and "MeadowGearOwned" or "MeadowGearOwned2" local b=i<=32 and i-1 or i-33 p:SetAttribute(f,bit32.bor(p:GetAttribute(f) or 0,bit32.lshift(1,b))) return i,it end end end
local out={}
local ci=give("guardian_armor") if ci then p:SetAttribute("MeadowEquipChest",ci) table.insert(out,"chest="..ci) end
local si,sit=nil,nil
for i,it in ipairs(Cfg.MeadowEquipment) do if it.Slot=="Shield" then si,sit=give(it.Id) break end end
if si then p:SetAttribute("MeadowEquipShield",si) table.insert(out,"shield="..sit.Id) end
return table.concat(out,",")
